subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Where a feature is draft-born, the system shall accept its locked version as planning input in place of prd:plan-new/FR-1, prd:plan-new/FR-27, and prd:contract-gate/FR-1, with its readiness conditions — FR-12 through FR-14, FR-16, and FR-38 through FR-42 — as the planning-entry gate.
rationale: This contract overrides the planning-entry rows for draft-born features (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-15)
fit_criterion: A locked draft-born fixture plans and projects without a PRD projection document, a design document, or the document contract gate; an open draft is refused (FR-6).
